area_overview: ChangeTracker itself: pending changes, manual/automatic detection, clearing tracking state, query tracking defaults, cascade/orphan timing, lazy loading toggle, AcceptAllChanges, and DebugView.
key_ideas: HasChanges answers whether EF currently sees pending tracked changes that matter for SaveChanges.
DetectChanges refreshes EF's in-memory tracked state by comparing current values to snapshots; it is local and does not query the database.
AutoDetectChangesEnabled=false does not stop tracking; it only stops EF from calling DetectChanges automatically in common paths.
Clear detaches all tracked entities and does not save anything.
QueryTrackingBehavior sets default LINQ query tracking behavior for the context, but explicit AsTracking/AsNoTracking can override per query.
CascadeDeleteTiming and DeleteOrphansTiming control when EF applies client-side cascade/orphan delete state transitions.
CascadeChanges forces cascade/orphan state transitions when timings are set to Never or when explicit control is required.
AcceptAllChanges marks successful changes as accepted, usually after SaveChanges; acceptAllChangesOnSuccess=false lets code delay that reset.
DebugView helps inspect tracked state, changed properties, FK values, and navigation relationships.
